sbar.situation: The bank is recovered: the main payment journey ran clean on two looks in a row, the last at 28 s. Payments, clearing and the gateway are working again.
sbar.background: The reconciliation session held a write lock on the ledger, so payments failed with '503 ledger busy'. Malformed queue item 90 crashed the clearing worker in parse(), and the scheduler had raised the gateway's balance_cache_ttl_s from 0.5 s to 600 s.
sbar.assessment: The incident commander ended the reconciliation session holding the ledger lock, which freed the ledger. It then set aside clearing item 90 and restarted clearing, which brought clearing back up. It also restored gateway balance_cache_ttl_s from 600 to 0.5 so customers see posted payments in their balances.
sbar.recommendation: Item 90 has been escalated to the operations team, who must review it and either repair and resubmit it or close it with its customer. Item 90 is a customer item that has not been cleared. Find out why the reconciliation job held a long write lock and why the scheduler changed balance_cache_ttl_s, so neither happens again.
